subject: general
question: ___________ Veda, shortest among the four Vedas, holds a divine status in Hindu tradition and is a collection of melodies and chants.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sama.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Sama Veda**, as mentioned in the statement, is the** shortest **among the four Vedas and is known for its collection of** melodies and chants.**​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Rig Veda **is considered the **oldest **and** most important **of the four Vedas.
 
• The** Yajur Veda** contains instructions for** rituals and sacrifices.**
 
• The **Atharva Veda** includes **spells and charms** for various purposes.
